_doc: Pearl ObjectEvent (0x20 bytes: pokeplatinum include/map_header_data.h:20-34; decoded by PearlB2 b2tools/gen4_extract.py:86-90) -> Black 2 ZoneNPC (0x24 bytes: pokebw2 include/field/field_actor.h:73-91; PearlB2 b2tools/zones.py:24,39-40, HoennB2 notes/GEN5_MAPS.md section 5). Same layout and order except Black 2's u32 isRail before the position: Gen 5 kept Gen 4's object record.

uid.how: copy (the local id Pearl's scripts address); unique per zone. HoennB2 appends story NPCs after existing ones and asserts no uid clash (b2tools/patches/story.py:251-257)

model.how: sprite_map.json code; VAR_0..4 (101-105) -> 162-166 (WKOBJCODE, work 0x4020+n: fldmmdl.c:1881-1890, WORK_OBJCODE_FIRST 0x4020 at :24); null = no actor (signs/doors/berry soil: BG event + building prop)

move.how: movement_types.json (identity except 47 berry soil and 51-53 disguises)

evtype.how: identity for 0,1,2,4,5,6,7; 3 (UNK_003, only 6 item balls) -> 0. Sight: Black 2 fldmmdl.c:1911-1924 folds 4-8,11-13 into 1, 2 = all ways (event_trainer_eye.c:95, :521); Gen 4 trainer_encounter.c:165-180 does the same. Walker turn handlers: Black 2 ACTOR_EVENTTYPE_FUNCS ov036 0x021cbdf0 (4 / 5,6 special) = Gen 4 unk_020673B8.c:369-397

flag.how: same meaning (actor not spawned while the flag is set: fldmmdl.c:300-307 SpawnAllZoneNPCs); Pearl flag ids must be renumbered into Black 2's flag space. 0 = always

script.how: local ids (<1000) -> the zone's new script file; 3000+id / 5000+id trainers (single / second of a double) are Black 2's own scheme (HoennB2 converter/gen_trainer_npcs.py:4-8, Black 2 zone 29 uid 1 = 3734) with the trainer id remapped; 7000+n item balls -> Black 2's item-ball scripts (7000-7399, own numbering); 10000 Cut -> 10004, 10002 Strength -> 10000, 10001 Rock Smash -> none (write one); 2000-2800 Pearl common scripts (2027 vent, 2037 snowball/E4 door, 2800 berry), 9xxx and 10151-10300 Pearl globals -> rewrite; 0xFFFF = clone of a neighbouring map's object: Black 2 keeps the rule (spawned regardless of flag: fldmmdl.c:302, IsNPCSCRID0xFFFF :1900). 48 Pearl clones (mostly signposts)

dir.how: identity: 0 N/up, 1 S/down, 2 W/left, 3 E/right (pokeplatinum constants/map_object.h:5-8, pokebw2 constants/directions.h:5-8)

p0.how: trainers: sight range in tiles (Pearl 0-7, Black 2 trainer NPCs 0-7, 90 of 415 with 0); signposts: text index (moot: no actor); berry soil: patch number. Never give model 185 a nonzero p0/p1 by accident: 185 reads them as its collision size (fldmmdl.c:400-407)

p1.how: steps before turning for evtype 4/5/6 walkers (Gen 4 unk_020673B8.c sub_0206762C reads data[1]; Black 2's own evtype-4/5/6 walkers carry p1 2-14 with move 20)

areaw.how: copy: spawn x +- range (pokeplatinum map_object_move.c:675-705; Black 2 field_actor_tool.c; -1/0xFFFF no limit, 0 fixed)

x.how: copy. Overworld: Pearl x is a matrix-global tile and PearlB2 installs Pearl's matrix 0 1:1 as Black 2 matrix 0 (data/sinnoh_world.json, notes/WORLD.md; b2tools/patches/sinnoh_events.py:80-106 places warps at x*16+8 from the same Pearl tiles); rooms: room-local tiles of their own matrix (installed 1:1 by sinnoh_rooms). NPC x/z are tiles in Black 2 too (u16 grid, field_actor.h ZoneNPCGridPosition; fldmmdl.c:425-450 pos.x = (x<<16)+0x8000). Only the zone changes: the NPC goes in the entity file of the Black 2 zone owning that tile

y.how: fx32. Pearl's json y = raw fx32 >> 16 (gen4_extract.py:90; pokeplatinum tools/jsoncnv/event.py:73 writes y*0x10000), i.e. 16-unit steps, and Black 2 reads gridY = (y >> 4) / FX32_ONE (fldmmdl.c:447): so b2 y = pearl_y << 16 (= height_units * 0x1000). Safer: the converted tile's height from PearlB2 work/world/heights_*.json * 0x1000 (what sinnoh_events does for warps). HoennB2 leaves people at y 0 except on bridge decks (story.py:250-256): Black 2 actors take the ground under them, y only picks the layer
